title: Pay with PayPal Pay in 4 (Buy Now, Pay Later) for ~A$24 off ~A$239, ~A$39 off ~A$388 Spend @ AliExpress
body:
Deal: Pay with PayPal Pay in 4 (Buy Now, Pay Later) for ~A$24 off ~A$239, ~A$39 off ~A$388 Spend @ AliExpress

[mynameisborat] I tried this during the previous sale. The prices were jacked up, and I was told on the app the discount only applied if I paid in AUD. I'm not sure what others experienced.
[Caped Baldy] So you're saying "hiiggghh prrriiiccceee"?
[Clear] AUD rate on the website is always off by up to 4% compared to the current exchange rate. Still combining PayPal BNPL, AliExpress Coupons, upsized TopCashback and Team OzBargain cashback you're going to end up with a much bigger saving than that <4% loss.
[AustriaBargain] Aliexpress often has different deals for the dozens of different currencies/regions they accept.
[Azif] Wish it was the normal payment not just bnpl
[Gcs] PayPal Pay in 4 never works for me. The worst product I have ever tried.
